HELP_STEPS.1: Start with a trigger: Webhook receives CRM events, Schedule runs on a timer.
HELP_STEPS.2: Drag the next steps from the Blocks panel onto the board.
HELP_STEPS.3: Pull the output dot on the right of a block onto the next block. Conditions have True and False outputs.
HELP_STEPS.4: Click a block to rename it, disable it or edit its parameters.
HELP_STEPS.5: Save to send the flow to n8n, then switch it to Active.

FLOW.HELP_NOTE: The flow is stored in n8n. Webhook blocks receive the CRM events listed on the n8n page; use the webhook path in the CRM automation rules.

EDITOR.NAME_REQUIRED: Give the flow a name before saving.
EDITOR.SUBTITLE: Starts when a new conversation arrives in {inboxes}
EDITOR.START_HELP: The flow starts when a customer opens a new conversation in the selected inboxes. It stops as soon as a person answers the conversation.
EDITOR.INBOXES_HELP: Leave all unchecked to run in every inbox.
EDITOR.STARTER_GREETING: Hi, {'{{'}contato.nome{'}}'}! Thanks for reaching out. Someone from our team will answer you shortly.
EDITOR.PALETTE_HINT_END: onto another block to connect them.
EDITOR.MENU_HELP: The customer answers with the number or the option text. Any other answer follows "Other answer", or repeats the menu when that output is not connected.
EDITOR.NO_LABELS: No labels yet. Create them in Settings → Labels.

HELP_STEPS.1: Drag a block from the Blocks panel onto the board.
HELP_STEPS.2: Pull the output of "New conversation" onto the first block.
HELP_STEPS.3: Connect each output to the next step. Questions and menus wait for the customer's reply; an output without a connection ends the flow.
HELP_STEPS.4: Click a block to write the message, the options or choose the team.
HELP_STEPS.5: Turn the flow on with the Active switch and save.

EDITOR.HELP_NOTE: The flow runs once per conversation and stops when an agent answers, here or from the phone, or when the conversation is resolved.

inactivity.LABEL: Inactivity
inactivity.DESCRIPTION: Path when the customer goes quiet

EDITOR.RULES_HELP: Rules are checked in order; the first true one picks the output. If none is, the flow follows Else.
EDITOR.EXPRESSIONS_HELP: Use expressions in double braces, such as flow.setor, user.cpfCnpj, input.text or flow.counter + 1.
EDITOR.INACTIVITY_HELP: From this block on, a customer silent for this long while the flow waits follows the Inactive output.
EDITOR.SUBFLOW_MISSING: No flow with this name has been imported yet. Until it exists, the block follows its error output.
EDITOR.RETURNS_HELP: When the other flow ends, this one continues through Success.
EDITOR.IMPORTED_TEAM: EZ.Chat department: {name}. AlvoChat uses the team with this name; pick another one above if you prefer.
EDITOR.WAIT_FOR_AGENT_HELP: The flow pauses during the human attendance and continues when the conversation is resolved (for a satisfaction survey, for example).
EDITOR.ONLY_IF_ONLINE_HELP: An offline person is not assigned; the next block can check input.online.
EDITOR.CODE_HELP: JavaScript code blocks do not run in AlvoChat. Code that only keeps the digits of the answer is recognised; other code follows the error output.
EDITOR.INTEGRATION_HELP: The {name} integration is not connected to AlvoChat yet. For now, the flow follows this block's error output.
